subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the B37 across all 3 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The B37 appears across three model lines — the 1 Series, X1 and X2 — in entry-level diesel form. It's not the most common engine we see, but it's a regular enough arrival in the workshop.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, and timing chain components where required on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the B37 across any of its applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed B37 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
